scenario.name: Benign Baseline (observe only)
scenario.description: Runs no attack. For ten minutes the platform only watches the lab, collecting ShopCloud's logs and the test container's events exactly as an attack run does, then checks them against every detection rule. Send normal traffic (for example tools/benign_traffic.py) while it runs: every alert it raises is a false positive.
